data.description:
## Testing Mode: GREEN

Rewrite _suppress_defended_findings in runner.py to use the existing proximity.py module for cited_lines-based matching, with a regression-masking carve-out and legacy description-prefix fallback.

## File
plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/runner.py

## Implementation

### Step 1: Import proximity module
Add to runner.py imports:
  from dso_ci_review.proximity import compute_proximity_overlap

### Step 2: Add carve-out helper
Add _inter_cycle_diff_modified_region(defense: dict, repo_root: str | None = None) -> bool:
- Reads story_branch_base_sha and story_branch_tip_sha from defense dict (exact field names from review-defenses.md contract)
- When both present: run git diff <base>..<tip> --unified=0 to get changed lines
- Parse diff hunks to extract modified line numbers per file
- Check if any modified line overlaps with defense['cited_lines'] within ±5 window (reuse compute_proximity_overlap logic or do direct line comparison)
- Returns False when SHA fields absent, empty, or git fails (fail-open — do not carve-out on error)

### Step 3: Rewrite _suppress_defended_findings
New logic per defense:
- If defense has non-empty cited_lines field:
  - Call _inter_cycle_diff_modified_region(defense) → if True, skip proximity suppression for this defense
  - Else: call compute_proximity_overlap(finding['cited_lines'], defense['cited_lines'])
  - On match: downgrade to 'suggestion' with _suppressed_reason='proximity match'
- Else (no cited_lines in defense): existing description[:80] fallback path UNCHANGED

## Acceptance
- T1 tests (test_suppress_proximity.py) all pass
- T2 replay tests (test_suppress_regression.py) both meet ≥60% threshold
- Existing test_suppress_defended_findings_downgrades_matching_findings (test_runner_smoke.py) still passes (legacy fallback preserved)
- Existing test_suppress_defended_findings_noop_when_no_defenses still passes
- ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py passes

## Dependencies (must be complete before starting this task)
- T1 (42ff-c87d-5b40-46ca): RED tests written
- T2 (c318-4280-2ecd-4c5f): fixtures + replay tests written
- T3 (e888-525e-783a-42df): review-defenses.md updated
